27: In 1962 Alfredo Sabatini opened seven tables on Via Principe Amedeo, a few steps from Termini station and the Esquilino market. He served what the neighbourhood recognised: egg pasta, slow-cooked meat, loose wine from the Castelli.
28: Sixty years on the room is the same — bordeaux panelling, sand-coloured linen, low light — but the kitchen has grown precise. We shop every day at the piazza Vittorio market, use only meat from Lazio farms, and keep about twenty dishes on the menu, not one more.
29: We are not after surprises: we are after the right dish, made properly, served without haste.
36: Vegetables and fish come from piazza Vittorio, the meat from the Roman countryside. If a product does not convince us, that dish is not on that day.
38: Eighty labels chosen among Cesanese, Frascati Superiore and small growers from Cori, with a by-the-glass selection that changes every week.

294: For sixty years the wine here was loose from the Castelli. Then Lazio began making serious wine, and the cellar changed: Cesanese from Piglio and Olevano, Bellone from the Anzio coast, Malvasia puntinata from Cori, Grechetto from the upper Viterbo hills.
295: We keep few bottles per label and buy straight from the growers, nearly all less than an hour from here. From outside the region only what we really need: a mountain red or two, a Verdicchio, the sparkling wines.
296: Eight wines by the glass change every week: they are written on the blackboard in the room. If you prefer, our Marco brings you two tastes and you choose.

364: Frequently asked questions | Ristorante Alfredo Rome — bookings, hours, allergies
369: How do I book a table?
375: . We answer every day from 10 am to 11 pm. For the same evening, a phone call is better.
377: Tuesday to Saturday 12.30–3 pm and 7–11.30 pm. Sunday lunch only, 12.30–4 pm. Closed Monday, the day for the market and for rest.
378: How do I get here from Termini?
379: We are at Via Principe Amedeo 126, four minutes on foot from the Via Giovanni Giolitti exit. Metro A and B, Termini stop; metro A, Vittorio Emanuele stop; buses 105 and 360.
380: Do you have gluten-free, vegetarian or vegan dishes?
381: Yes. Gluten-free pasta is cooked in a dedicated pot with dedicated tools: please tell us when you book. There are always at least three vegetarian and two vegan dishes on the menu — the puntarelle and the artichokes above all. The allergen list is available in the dining room.
382: Do you take groups and large tables?
383: Up to fourteen people with a menu agreed in advance. To take the whole room — forty-two covers — write to us at least three weeks ahead: we will prepare something made to measure.
385: Gladly, in the dining room and on the terrace. Bowl and water are on us.
387: In the underground car park at piazza Vittorio Emanuele II, 400 metres away, open until midnight. The restricted traffic zone is only active in some evening bands at weekends: ask us to confirm when you book.
388: Do you do takeaway or delivery?
389: Takeaway yes, ordered on WhatsApp by 6 pm for dinner. Home delivery no: some dishes do not survive the journey, and we would rather not serve them badly.
